_comment: Who runs each crawler, why it visits, and how to verify it. Keys match crawler patterns case-insensitively. Categories: training, ai_search, user_action, search_engine, seo, other.

GPTBot.description: Collects public web content to train OpenAI models.

OAI-SearchBot.description: Indexes pages so they can appear in ChatGPT search results.

ChatGPT-User.description: Fetches a page because a ChatGPT user asked about it.

ClaudeBot.description: Collects public web content to train Claude models.

Claude-SearchBot.description: Indexes pages to improve Claude's search results.

Claude-User.description: Fetches a page because a Claude user asked about it.

Googlebot.description: Google Search crawler. Content may also be used by AI Overviews.

Google-Extended.description: robots.txt token controlling use of content for Gemini training; requests come from Googlebot.

GoogleOther.description: Generic Google crawler used by product teams, including research and development.

Google-CloudVertexBot.description: Fetches sites for Vertex AI agents built by Google Cloud customers.

Google-InspectionTool.description: Search Console URL inspection and Rich Results Test.

bingbot.description: Bing Search crawler; also grounds Copilot answers.

PerplexityBot.description: Indexes pages for Perplexity search answers.

Perplexity-User.description: Fetches a page because a Perplexity user asked about it.

Applebot-Extended.description: robots.txt token controlling use of Applebot-crawled content for Apple Intelligence training.

Amazonbot.description: Improves Amazon services such as Alexa answers; may be used for model training.

FacebookBot.description: Crawls public pages to improve Meta's language and speech models.

Meta-ExternalAgent.description: Collects content to train Meta AI models and index it.

Meta-ExternalFetcher.description: Fetches a page because a Meta AI user asked about it.

LLaMA-Bot.description: Unofficial or legacy Meta LLaMA crawler name.

MetaGPT.description: Open-source agent framework user agent, not an official OpenAI or Meta crawler.

CCBot.description: Builds the open Common Crawl dataset, widely used to train LLMs.

Bytespider.description: ByteDance crawler; content is used to train models such as Doubao.

cohere-ai.description: Fetches pages for Cohere chat responses.

cohere-training-data-crawler.description: Collects content to train Cohere models.

AI2Bot.description: Collects content to train open language models.

AI2Bot-Dolma.description: Builds the open Dolma training dataset.

MistralAI-User.description: Fetches a page because a Le Chat user asked about it.

DuckAssistBot.description: Fetches pages to write DuckAssist AI answers.

PanguBot.description: Collects content to train Huawei PanGu models.

Youbot.description: Indexes pages for You.com AI search.

Diffbot.description: Extracts structured data for Diffbot's knowledge graph and AI products.

Omgili.description: Webz.io crawler; data is sold, including for AI training.

Omgilibot.description: Webz.io crawler; data is sold, including for AI training.

webzio-extended.description: robots.txt token controlling Webz.io data use for AI training.

Kangaroo Bot.description: Collects content to train Kangaroo LLM.

img2dataset.description: Tool that downloads images in bulk to build training datasets.

Sentibot.description: Social listening and brand monitoring crawler.

Seekr.description: Content evaluation for AI and advertising.

Scrapy.description: Default user agent of the Scrapy scraping framework; anyone can use it.

AhrefsBot.description: Ahrefs SEO index; also powers Ahrefs' AI features.
